quote_zh: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物56.84g、三乙胺37.95g、PdCl2催化剂0.4g、配体1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷3.98g、溶剂1,4-二氧六环300g，抽真空，氮气置换3次，以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80～85℃反应约8h后降温至70℃，加入2g丙酮氰醇，继续反应5h。
arithmetic_check: Stated input: 56.84 g of 式(IV)化合物, drawn as C10H9BrClF3O3S (MW 381.59), giving 0.1489 mol. On 0.1489 mol that yield would correspond to 0.0963 mol of tembotrione (C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82), about 42.5 g, but the patent prints no mass to compare that with, so nothing can be shown to disagree and mass_balance_implausible is not raised. The other charges cannot be checked as ratios either, since only masses are given: triethylamine 37.95 g, PdCl2 0.4 g, ligand 3.98 g, dioxane 300 g, acetone cyanohydrin 2 g. Nothing in the section is internally inconsistent.
